title: ConformalMOS: Uncertainty-Aware MOS Prediction with Conformal Intervals and Ordinal Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2610.36126v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate prediction of human Mean Opinion Scores (MOS) is crucial for evaluating synthetic speech quality in text-to-speech (TTS) and voice conversion (VC). Most MOS predictors output only point estimates and ignore uncertainty, limiting reliability in model selection and deployment. We propose ConformalMOS, a framework that augments MOS prediction with conformal prediction to produce statistically valid prediction intervals with guaranteed coverage under exchangeability, alongside point estimates. During training, MOS labels are modeled in an ordinal-aware manner by converting one-hot targets into Gaussian-smoothed distributions, preserving score ordering. This improves uncertainty calibration, particularly when softmax confidence is overconfident on out-of-distribution speech. On BVCC datasets, ConformalMOS achieves competitive accuracy (MSE = 0.08) while delivering empirically validated coverage, enhancing reliability for real-world

translated_title: ConformalMOS：基于保形区间与序数建模的不确定性感知MOS预测
translated_abstract: 准确预测人类平均意见得分（MOS）对于评估文本转语音（TTS）和语音转换（VC）中合成语音的质量至关重要。大多数MOS预测器仅输出点估计而忽略不确定性，这限制了模型选择和部署的可靠性。我们提出ConformalMOS，这是一个通过保形预测增强MOS预测的框架，在提供点估计的同时，生成在可交换性条件下具有覆盖率保证的统计有效预测区间。在训练过程中，MOS标签以序数感知的方式进行建模，通过将独热目标转换为高斯平滑分布来保持评分的顺序性。这改善了不确定性校准，特别是在softmax置信度对分布外语音过度自信的情况下。在BVCC数据集上，ConformalMOS实现了具有竞争力的准确度（MSE = 0.08），同时提供了经过实证验证的覆盖率，提高了实际应用场景中的可靠性。
tldr: 提出ConformalMOS框架，结合保形预测生成具有覆盖率保证的预测区间，并采用序数感知的高斯平滑标签建模，在保持MOS预测准确度的同时实现可靠的不确定性量化。
en_tdlr: ConformalMOS augments MOS prediction with conformal prediction intervals featuring guaranteed coverage and ordinal-aware Gaussian-smoothed label modeling, achieving competitive accuracy while enabling reliable uncertainty quantification for synthetic speech evaluation.
